criteria: Only scanner/src/dogwatch/config.py and scanner/tests/test_config.py are created; pyproject.toml, uv.lock and diagnostics.py are unchanged.

config.py exposes `load_policy(config_arg: str) -> PolicyConfig` and frozen `PackageDecl(name, root)` / `PolicyConfig(path_arg, raw, packages)` exactly per DC-2, raising DogwatchError from diagnostics.py on failure.

Every DC-1 stderr template has a test asserting the diagnostic id and each named placeholder value (never interpreter message text): V0 missing path; V1 directory-as-config and invalid UTF-8; V2 malformed TOML with correct line number on 3.11 and 3.14; V3 `[[python.rules]]`, `[openapi]`, `python.packages[0].include`, empty file, missing packages, wrong types, dotted name `a.b`; V4 missing directory, file-instead-of-directory, duplicate, split, nested.
A config with several V4 failures yields one Diagnostic per failure in DC-1 order (V4a per entry, then V4b over pairs i<j); a UTF-8 BOM fails as invalid TOML (utf-8 decode, G-7).

items.title: Implement the post-build JS/CSS budget and CSP gate check-build.mjs
criteria: Only web/scripts/check-build.mjs and web/scripts/check-build.test.mjs are created (INV-W6 assertions live in check-build.mjs); package.json, vite.config.ts and src/** are unchanged; only Node built-ins (zlib, fs, path) are used.

check-build.mjs reads dist/.vite/manifest.json, sums gzip level-9 size of the isEntry chunk plus transitive static imports (excluding dynamicImports) against an initial-route JS budget of 100000 bytes, and gzip level-9 of all dist/**/*.css against a 20000-byte CSS budget, printing `js-initial <n>/100000` and `css-total <n>/20000`.

Synthetic temp-dir tests: over-budget JS -> exit 1; over-budget CSS -> exit 1; inline <script> -> exit 1; `onclick=` (regex /\son[a-z]+\s*=/i) -> exit 1; missing manifest -> exit 1; a dynamic-import chunk is excluded from the JS sum; a compliant dist -> exit 0 with both lines printed.
INV-W6: an `https?://` reference in a src/href/@import/url( context anywhere under dist/ makes the gate exit 1.
INV-W5 on the real build: `make build-web` exits 0 and prints js-initial <= 100000 and css-total <= 20000.
`make install-web lint-web test-web build-web` passes in a clean clone with only Node and pnpm (checkpoint CP-2/web complete).

evidence: Accepted. The branch adds only web/scripts/check-build.mjs and its test, and uses only Node built-ins (zlib, fs, path).
